title: I’m working on a cozy hotel and shop management game where you stock the shop with items from exploration in the backrooms.
author: jakobpinders
selftext:
The game is called the In Between and you run a roadside shop and motel that caters to unusual customers. You keep the shop running by selling anomaly-style items that you gather from exploration and quests in the backrooms. 

So far it has ten different possible backroom biomes with different entities, over 80 different anomaly items to collect from the backrooms, quests, or traveling merchants. You can either sell these items or use them to decorate your hotel and the rooms and some give fun effects like causing rain to appear on windows when it’s a clear sky outside. 

You can upgrade the hotel in a variety of different ways such as decorating rooms individually, changing paint and trim colors, adding a second floor, a pool or a rec room. 

The actual exploration in the backrooms is rogue-like with more of a horror theme rather than a fighting-based style. It had 100 procedural levels that play out differently every time you play. 

Other fun features include:

Day and night cycle 

Hotel and shop maintenance 

Customers park cars and will sit in the courtyard and will comment on improvements or additions to rooms they rent 

Different secret puzzles and challenges on different levels of the backrooms 

Furniture crafting from blueprints
